== Description ==

[[Ming Huo]] (front left (back), grey tee, khaki shorts), [[Daniel Amor]] (front table left facing camera, olive-green hoodie, glasses), [[Nathan Russell]] (front table right, dark grey Mario tee, glasses, balding), [[Garrett Larson]] (stream table back-left, pink cap, beard), [[Brian Fred]] (stream table back-left, bald, black tee, black shorts), [[Logan Pietig]] (second table left, black UWL hoodie (partial)), [[Jonny Chu]] (second table center, black zip hoodie over purple tee), [[Anthony Howard]] (second table right, black tee, dark beard), [[Robbie Hendon]] (standing mid-back left, grey tee, grey cap, goatee), [[Justin Miyashiro]] (standing center (back), black tee, white cargo shorts, red slides), and [[Hayes Hunter]] (standing foreground right (back), tall, dark grey shirt, jeans) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
